title: ni_sh_a.char-IDE language definition
description: One file per language. Adding a language means adding one of these -- no source code changes.

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier. Must match the filename.

aliases.description: Alternative names users may type, e.g. ['py', 'python3'].

comment.description: Line-comment prefix, used by the editor for toggle-comment.

highlight.description: Syntax highlighting mode id used by the web editor.

image.description: Container image for the sandboxed Docker runner.

setup.description: Commands run inside the container before the program. Docker tier only.

compile.description: Compile steps run in order before 'run'. Omit for interpreted languages.

run.description: The command that executes the program.

browser.description: In-browser (tier 0) engine, if this language can run with no backend.

template.description: Hello-world starter shown when the language is selected.

filename.description: Exact source filename to write, when the toolchain requires one (e.g. Java needs Main.java). Defaults to main<first extension>.

argv.description: Argument vector. Never a shell string -- arguments are passed directly, so no shell quoting or injection is possible. Supported placeholders: {file} source path, {bin} compiled output path, {dir} workspace directory, {stem} filename without extension.
